methods.name: withdraw
methods.description: Debits the caller's balance of the asset and registers a withdrawal of the amount to the L1 recipient.

events.name: Deposited
events.description: A deposit credited to the account's balance.

events.name: Withdrawn
events.description: A withdrawal debited from the account's balance and registered for the L1 recipient.

errors.name: InsufficientBalance
errors.description: The caller's balance of the asset is below the requested amount.

errors.name: BalanceOverflow
errors.description: Crediting the deposit would overflow the u256 balance.

errors.name: InvalidRecipient
errors.description: The recipient is not a user address (first byte 0x00, not all zero).

errors.name: MalformedPayload
errors.description: a non-empty payload is shorter than a selector, or its arguments do not decode or do not fill the method's exact length

errors.name: UnknownSelector
errors.description: no method has the payload's selector

errors.name: CapExceeded
errors.description: an item added to the effects would break a §25.1 cap, or does not fit the effects arena or the output buffer

errors.name: ClaimAboveDeposit
errors.description: claim_deposit(x) with x above the claimable amount

errors.name: StoredValueDecode
errors.description: a stored value fails to decode

errors.name: InvalidRecipient
errors.description: withdraw() to an L1 address that is not a user address

storage.name: balances
storage.description: An absent leaf is a zero balance.
